mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1450 thousand units signal robust consumer demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1450, or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns by at least 0.5% per trade.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market, increasing consumer spending power and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling occurs without positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime, a current industrial production value below 102 signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102 in a high-inflation regime, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months indicates expanding economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 5-day returns in rising GDPC1 periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer credit (RSAFS) coupled with a declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong consumer spending and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS rising and FEDFUNDS falling occurs without positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime, rising employment (PAYEMS) signals tight labor market conditions and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises in a low-unemployment regime, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.
